lines.zh: 发出一阵刺耳的金属摩擦声
电路板发出轻微的闪烁
电路板发出低频的嗡嗡声
发出一阵轻微的咔哒声
身体卡在原地，腿却迈动
lines.en: My body sticks in place while my legs step.

lines.zh: 参数错乱，步伐忽快忽慢
lines.en: My parameters scramble, my pace stutters.

lines.zh: 发出一阵轻微的嗡嗡声
发出一阵微弱的电流声
发出一阵微弱的嗡鸣声
发出一阵机械的嗡嗡声
发出一阵轻微的哒哒声
渲染出现了一瞬间的撕裂
lines.en: The rendering tears for a split second.
Every number on my panel reads zero.
eyes swivel to look at player

lines.zh: 发出一阵轻微的摩擦声

lines.en: I buzz and lift my eyes to you.
mechanical arm raises to point at player

lines.zh: 发出一阵低沉的嗡鸣声
我咔哒一声，转向你的脸。
lines.en: I click once and turn to your face.

lines.zh: 发出一阵轻微的机械声
视线穿过你，落在你身后
lines.en: My gaze passes through you, to what's behind.
My eyes flicker and fail to focus.
I replay the same frame over and over.
It stares as if reading your data.

lines.zh: 视线锁定，带着坏掉的频率
lines.en: It locks on with a broken frequency.

lines.zh: 它歪过头，眼睛亮了一下
lines.en: It tilts its head, eyes flaring once.
Its pupils shrink into garbled code.
It seems to know you, then forgets.

lines.zh: 目光扫过，像在校验编号
lines.en: Its gaze sweeps you like an ID check.

lines.zh: 它用发红的眼睛记录你
lines.en: It records you with a red-lit eye.

lines.zh: 错误码顺着我的关节往上爬。
lines.en: Error codes crawl up through my joints.

lines.zh: 我的贴图开始一块块丢失。
lines.en: My texture is dropping out patch by patch.

lines.zh: 你靠近了我太多，我会出故障的。
让我冷静一下，别靠近我。

lines.en: Stay away from my line of sight.

lines.zh: 不要触摸我，你会损坏的。
我需要保持稳定，别干扰我。
lines.en: I need to stay stable. Don't disturb me.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就会重启。
我的系统不稳定，远离我。
lines.en: My systems are unstable. Stay away.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，我无法预测。
lines.en: You hit me. I can't predict.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，我可能出故障。
你撞了我，我的行为无法预测。
lines.en: You hit me. My behavior is unpredictable.
I got hit. I might crash.
You touched me. I'll go rogue.
I got hit. I might glitch.

lines.zh: 我需要一个固定的伴侣。
一个可靠的伴侣很重要。
寻找一个稳定的伴侣，保持平衡。
lines.en: Find a stable partner to maintain balance.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣必须是固定的。
一个稳定的伴侣才能长久。
寻找一个不会故障的伴侣。
lines.en: Find a partner that won't glitch.
Drip, metal cracks, here I come.

lines.zh: 螺丝松，金属脆，我要吃你。
lines.en: Loose bolts, metal brittle, I’ll eat you.

lines.zh: 齿轮响，铁生锈，你是我的。
lines.en: Cogs clank, iron rusted, you’re mine.

lines.zh: 金属响，我饥饿，你会颤抖。
lines.en: Metal clang, I’m hungry, you’ll shiver.

lines.zh: 螺丝响，金属裂，你是我的。
lines.en: Bolts rattle, metal breaks, you’re mine.
Iron chains rattle, I’ll grab you.
Metal brittle, here I am, run now.
Cogs turn, chains rattle, I won’t stop.
Iron chains wrap, here I come.

lines.zh: 它的头转向你，卡了一下
lines.en: Its head turns toward you and hitches.

lines.zh: 距离过近，触发清除程序
运算崩坏，它选择了攻击
lines.en: The math collapses. It chooses attack.

lines.zh: 手指抬起，对着你的方向
lines.en: A finger rises, aimed your way.
Its shadow stretches and coils toward you.

lines.zh: 故障扩散，你被圈进去了
lines.en: The fault spreads and draws you in.
Signal interference, and it closes in.

lines.zh: 倒计时结束，攻击即将开始
它在等你眨眼的那一帧
lines.en: It waits for the frame you blink.

lines.zh: 我的手臂缺了半截，还是砸下来。
lines.en: Half my arm is missing, yet it still comes down.
Did you smell that? My scent!

lines.zh: 错误已经写进这一帧了。
lines.en: The error is already written into this frame.

lines.zh: 这一下连帧都没有，你躲不开。
lines.en: This strike has no frames at all — you can't dodge it.

lines.zh: 你被写进了这段故障里。
lines.en: You've been written into this glitch.
It slices you with bad code.

lines.zh: 接触的一瞬，世界闪了一下
它抓住你，画面开始撕裂
lines.en: It grabs you and the screen tears.
The blow lands and sound is swallowed.
It presses you into the error.
I’m a glitch, here I come!

lines.zh: 出生点卡住了，我站了整夜。
lines.en: My spawn point is stuck; I've stood here all night.
I’m an error in the program!

lines.zh: 房间里多了一个不该有的实体
lines.en: The room gains an entity that shouldn't exist.

lines.zh: 它从错误的坐标里生成
lines.en: It spawns from the wrong coordinates.

lines.zh: 代码漏了一行，它就出现了
lines.en: One line slipped away, and it appeared.

lines.zh: 画面一闪，它站到你面前
lines.en: The screen flashes and it stands before you.

lines.zh: 在无人注意的地方加载完毕
lines.en: It finished loading where no one watched.

lines.zh: 它从生成起没动过一步
lines.en: It hasn't moved a step since spawning.
The save was never supposed to have it.

lines.zh: 它在出生点卡住了很久
lines.en: It has been stuck at its spawn point.
Loading complete. It looks up at you.

lines.zh: 世界眨了下眼，它在场了
lines.en: The world blinks, and it is here.
It was dropped here with nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 我摔出地面，坐标全错了。
lines.en: I fall through the floor — my coordinates are all wrong.

lines.zh: 我只是一段坏掉的代码。
lines.en: I'm just a broken bit of code.

lines.zh: 虚空里，连故障都会消失。
lines.en: In the void, even errors vanish.
